A.text: In a certain code language, MATHS is written as NBUIT. Using the same rule, how will SCIENCE be written?
steps: Compare MATHS and NBUIT letter by letter: M→N, A→B, T→U, H→I, S→T.
Each letter is shifted forward by 1 in the alphabet.
Apply the same shift to SCIENCE: S→T, C→D, I→J, E→F, N→O, C→D, E→F.
So SCIENCE is coded as TDJFODF.

A.text: If BOOK is coded as 2-15-15-11, what word does the code 4-1-20-5 represent?
steps: The code uses each letter's position in the alphabet (A=1, B=2, ... Z=26).

A.text: Find the next number in the series: 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, 36, ___
Find the missing term in the letter series: A, D, I, P, ___
steps: Find the position of each letter: A=1, D=4, I=9, P=16.
The next position is 5² = 25, which is the letter Y.

A.text: DOCTOR : HOSPITAL :: TEACHER : ___
steps: A doctor works at a hospital.
In the same way, a teacher works at a school.
Notice that 6 × 6 = 36 — the first number is the square of the second.

A.text: Which of the following is the odd one out?
Which word does NOT belong to the group?
steps: Scalene, Isosceles, and Equilateral are all types of triangles.
Rectangle is a quadrilateral, not a triangle — it doesn't belong.

A.text: A rectangular field is 80 m long and 50 m wide. A farmer walks along its boundary twice. What is the total distance walked?
steps: Walking around the boundary twice = 2 × 260 = 520 m.

A.text: How many millilitres are equal to 2.5 litres?
In a row of 25 children, Aryan is 8th from the left and Meera is 12th from the right. How many children are seated between them?
In quadrilateral ABCD, ∠A = 90°, ∠B = 85°, and ∠C = 110°. Find ∠D.
steps: The angles of any quadrilateral add up to 360°.

A.text: Which grouping is correct? Group P: {4, 8, 12, 16, 20} — claimed to be multiples of 4. Group Q: {9, 18, 27, 36, 44} — claimed to be multiples of 9.
steps: Group P: 4, 8, 12, 16, 20 are all multiples of 4 — correct.
Group Q: 9, 18, 27, 36 are multiples of 9, but 44 is not (9×5=45, not 44).
So only Group P is correct.

A.text: Both diagonals are drawn inside a rectangle. How many triangles are formed in total?
steps: The two diagonals split the rectangle into 4 small triangles meeting at the centre.
Each diagonal alone also splits the rectangle into 2 large triangles — there are 4 such large triangles (one along each diagonal-plus-two-sides combination).

A.text: Each interior angle of a regular polygon is 120°. How many sides does the polygon have?
Which of the following is a triangular number?
Two lines intersect at a point. One of the angles formed measures 65°. What is the measure of the vertically opposite angle?
steps: Vertically opposite angles are always equal.
So the vertically opposite angle also measures 65°.

A.text: Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal. The co-interior angles (same-side interior angles) are in the ratio 2 : 3. Find the measure of the larger angle.
steps: Co-interior angles are supplementary — they add up to 180°.

A.text: For which of the following options does EVERY number have a digit-sum equal to 18 AND is also divisible by 9?
steps: For the other options, at least one number has a digit sum that isn't 18 (e.g. 456: 4+5+6=15, or 399: 3+9+9=21, or 346: 3+4+6=13).
So option A is the only one where every number qualifies.

A.text: The mean of 5 numbers is 24. When one number is removed, the mean of the remaining 4 numbers becomes 21. What is the number that was removed?
Which of the following pairs of numbers are co-prime (their HCF is 1)?
steps: Check the HCF of each pair.
14,21 share factor 7. 15,35 share factor 5. 18,27 share factor 9.
16=2⁴ and 25=5² share no common factor — HCF=1, so they're co-prime.

A.text: The perimeter of a square is 48 cm. What is its area?
What must be subtracted from 5⅔ to get 2¾?
Arrange the following fractions in ascending order: 3/4, 7/8, 2/3, 5/6
steps: Convert all fractions to a common denominator of 24: 3/4=18/24, 7/8=21/24, 2/3=16/24, 5/6=20/24.

A.text: Using a ruler and compass, a 90° angle is constructed and then bisected. The resulting angle is then bisected once more. What angle is finally obtained?
Which capital letter of the English alphabet has BOTH a horizontal AND a vertical line of symmetry?
steps: A and T only have a vertical line of symmetry.
Y only has a vertical line of symmetry.
H looks the same when flipped top-to-bottom AND left-to-right — it has both.

A.text: The temperature in Shimla at noon is 8°C. By midnight it drops by 15°C. What is the temperature at midnight?
What is the place value of digit 6 in the number 34,56,789?
steps: Writing out the number: 3,4,5,6,7,8,9 — the digit 6 sits in the thousands place.

A.text: Which number is the same as: 8,00,000 + 50,000 + 4,000 + 700 + 30 + 9?
Find the LCM of 12, 18, and 24.
steps: LCM takes the highest power of each prime: 2³×3² = 8×9 = 72.

A.text: Which of the following is a factor of 72?
A rope 7.5 m long is cut into pieces of 0.5 m each. How many pieces are obtained?
What is 3/5 of 2 hours 30 minutes?
A train travels at 60 km/h. How far does it travel in 2 hours 30 minutes?
In the number pattern 1, 3, 7, 13, 21, 31, 43, ___ , what is the 8th term?
steps: Look at the differences: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12 — each is 2 more than the last.

A.text: Riya completed 2/5 of her homework in the morning and 1/3 in the afternoon. What fraction of her homework is still remaining?
steps: Homework done so far: 2/5 + 1/3. Common denominator 15: 6/15 + 5/15 = 11/15.

A.text: A rectangular garden is 120 m long and 80 m wide. A uniform path 2 m wide runs inside along the entire boundary. What is the area of the path alone?
steps: Inner area (garden minus the 2 m path on each side) = (120−4) × (80−4) = 116 × 76 = 8816 m².

A.text: Six students scored 72, 85, 68, 92, 78, and 65 marks in a test. What is the median of their scores?
steps: With 6 values, the median is the average of the 3rd and 4th: (72+78)/2 = 75.

A.text: A number, when divided by 8, leaves a remainder of 3. When the same number is divided by 4, what is the remainder?
steps: The number can be written as 8k + 3.
8k is divisible by 4, so dividing by 4 leaves the same remainder as 3 ÷ 4, which is 3.

A.text: Three bells ring at intervals of 12, 15, and 18 minutes respectively. If all three ring together at 9:00 AM, at what time will they next all ring together?
On a number line, Devan starts at 0, moves 8 units to the right, then 15 units to the left. What is his final position?
A shopkeeper had 3 kg 250 g of sugar and sold 1 kg 750 g. How much sugar is left?
Each book costs ₹125.50. Kavya buys 4 books and pays ₹600. How much change does she receive?
A factory produces 12,500 units per day and runs 7 days a week. How many units does it produce in 4 weeks?
The length of a rectangle is 3 times its breadth. If the perimeter is 96 cm, what is its area?
steps: Perimeter = 2(l+b) = 96, so l+b = 48. With l = 3b: 3b+b = 48, so b = 12 and l = 36.

A.text: A number N leaves remainder 5 when divided by 6, remainder 7 when divided by 8, and remainder 11 when divided by 12. What is the smallest possible value of N?
steps: Notice: 6−5=1, 8−7=1, and 12−11=1 — in each case N is exactly 1 less than a multiple of the divisor.
So N+1 must be divisible by 6, 8, and 12, meaning N+1 is a multiple of LCM(6,8,12) = 24.
The smallest such N+1 is 24, so N = 23.

A.text: Priya walks 3/4 km every hour and Karan walks 5/6 km every hour. After 6 hours, how much farther has Karan walked than Priya?
A rectangle is 27 cm long and 12 cm wide. A square is drawn with the same area. What is the difference between the perimeter of the rectangle and the perimeter of the square?
steps: Side of the equal-area square = √324 = 18 cm, so its perimeter = 4×18 = 72 cm.

A.text: Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal. The ratio of a pair of co-interior angles is 2 : 7. Find the measure of the larger angle.
The sum of three consecutive integers is −12. If P denotes the product of the smallest and the largest of these integers, find the value of P + (the middle integer).
steps: Let the integers be n−1, n, n+1. Their sum is 3n = −12, so n = −4.

B.text: In a certain code, each letter is shifted forward by 2 places (A→C, B→D, …). How is BRUSH written using this rule?
steps: Shift each letter of BRUSH forward by 2 places in the alphabet.
So BRUSH is coded as DTWUJ.

B.text: If ORANGE is coded as 15-18-1-14-7-5, what word does the code 7-18-1-16-5 represent? (A=1, B=2, … Z=26)
steps: Each number gives a letter's position: 7=G, 18=R, 1=A, 16=P, 5=E.

B.text: Find the next term in the series: 3, 8, 15, 24, 35, ___
Find the missing term in the letter series: B, E, H, K, ___
steps: B(2), E(5), H(8), K(11) — each letter is 3 positions after the last.

B.text: Fish : Aquarium :: Bird : ___
steps: A fish is commonly kept in an aquarium (an enclosure).
In the same way, a bird kept as a pet is kept in a cage.
7×7 = 49 — the first number is the square of the second.

B.text: Which of the following is the odd one out?
steps: 48 is not a perfect square, so it is the odd one out.

B.text: Which word does NOT belong to the group?
steps: Obtuse, Acute, and Reflex are all types of angles.
Scalene describes a type of triangle, not an angle — it doesn't belong.

B.text: A bag weighs 3.5 kg. What is this in grams?
How many minutes are in 3 days and 4 hours?
In a queue, Sanya is 5th from the front. From the back, she is 9th. How many people are in the queue?
steps: Total = position from front + position from back − 1.

B.text: Two angles of a triangle are 45° and 75°. What is the measure of the third angle?
steps: The angles of a triangle add up to 180°.

B.text: Which grouping is correct? Group X: {2, 3, 5, 7, 11} — claimed to be prime numbers. Group Y: {4, 9, 16, 25, 37} — claimed to be perfect squares.
steps: Group X: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11 are all prime — correct.
Group Y: 4, 9, 16, 25 are perfect squares, but 37 is not (6²=36, 7²=49).
So only Group X is correct.

B.text: All three medians are drawn inside a triangle. Into how many smaller triangles is the triangle divided?
steps: The three medians of a triangle all meet at one point (the centroid).
This divides the triangle into 6 smaller triangles.

B.text: The sum of the exterior angles of any convex polygon, taken one at each vertex, is always:
steps: This is a fixed geometric fact: the exterior angles of any convex polygon always add up to 360°, no matter how many sides it has.

B.text: Which number is BOTH a perfect square AND a triangular number?
steps: 36 is triangular (it's the 8th triangular number) AND 36 = 6² is a perfect square.
9, 16, and 25 are perfect squares but don't appear in the triangular number list.

B.text: Two angles are supplementary. One angle is 24° more than the other. Find the larger angle.
steps: Supplementary angles add to 180°. Let the smaller be x, so x + (x+24) = 180.

B.text: Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal. An alternate interior angle measures 55°. What is the value of the co-interior angle on the same side?
steps: Alternate interior angles are equal, so the corresponding one is also 55°.
A co-interior angle is supplementary to it: 180 − 55 = 125°.

B.text: A 2-digit number has its tens digit exactly 3 more than its units digit. Which of the following numbers satisfies this AND is also divisible by 4?
steps: Check the digit condition (tens = units + 3) for each: 41(4-1=3✓), 52(5-2=3✓), 63(6-3=3✓), 74(7-4=3✓) — all satisfy it.
Now check divisibility by 4: 41÷4 no, 52÷4=13 yes, 63÷4 no, 74÷4 no.

B.text: The scores of a cricket player in 7 matches are: 45, 72, 38, 72, 55, 38, 72. What is the mode of this data?
steps: 72 appears 3 times, 38 appears twice, and 45 and 55 appear once each.
The most frequent value (the mode) is 72.

B.text: Find the HCF of 84 and 126.
A triangle has base 16 cm and height 8 cm. A square has the same area as this triangle. Find the perimeter of the square.
steps: Side of the equal-area square = √64 = 8 cm.

B.text: Find the product: 2⅓ × 1⅘
Divide 5¼ by ¾.
How many circles can be drawn passing through three given non-collinear points?
steps: Three points that don't lie on a straight line always determine exactly one circle — their unique circumscribed circle.

B.text: What is the order of rotational symmetry of an equilateral triangle?
steps: An equilateral triangle looks the same after rotating it by 120°, 240°, and 360°.
That's 3 positions, so its order of rotational symmetry is 3.

B.text: Arrange in descending order: −5, +3, −8, 0, +6, −1
steps: Sorting all six values from largest to smallest: 6, 3, 0, −1, −5, −8.

B.text: Find the product: 7,842 × 105
Find the HCF of 36 and 60.
Which fraction lies between 1/3 and 1/2?
Which of the following has the greatest value?
A jug holds 2.4 litres of juice. If 0.15 litres is poured into each glass, how many full glasses can be filled?
A film starts at 3:45 PM and runs for 2 hours 35 minutes. At what time does it end?
In the pattern 1, 2, 4, 7, 11, 16, ___, what is the next term?
steps: The differences are 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 — increasing by 1 each time.
Next difference is 6, so the next term = 16 + 6 = 22.

B.text: A tank is 3/4 full of water. After using 1/5 of the total water in the tank, what fraction remains?
steps: The tank currently holds 3/4 of its capacity.
Using 1/5 of that water removes 1/5 × 3/4 = 3/20 of the tank's capacity.

B.text: A square playground has a perimeter of 160 m. What is the cost of laying grass at ₹12 per square metre?
The number of books read by 5 students are: 7, 12, 5, 15, 11. What is the difference between the mean and the median?
What is the largest 4-digit number that is exactly divisible by 18?
steps: 9999 ÷ 18 = 555.5, so 555×18 = 9990 is the largest multiple of 18 that's still a 4-digit number.

B.text: Two buses leave the same stop every 24 and 36 minutes respectively. Both leave together at 7:00 AM. When do they next leave together?
The lowest recorded temperature of a city was −28°C and the highest was 43°C. What is the difference between the two temperatures?
A car travels 348 km using 24 litres of petrol. How many kilometres does it travel per litre?
A shopkeeper sold items worth ₹245.75, ₹178.50, and ₹312.25. What is the total amount collected?
A worker works 8 hours 45 minutes each day. What is the total time worked over 5 days?
A rectangular piece of land is 85 m long and 60 m wide. The cost of fencing its boundary is ₹45 per metre. Find the total cost.
The sum of the first n natural numbers is n(n+1)/2. If this sum equals 210, find n.
Three friends share a pizza. Anika eats 1/3, Bharat eats 2/7, and Chitra eats the rest. If the pizza is cut into 21 equal slices, how many slices does Chitra eat?
A farmer has 200 m of fencing and wishes to fence a rectangular field with one side along a river (no fencing needed on that side). What is the maximum area he can enclose?
steps: Let the two fenced sides perpendicular to the river each be x, and the side parallel to the river be y.
Area = xy = x(200−2x) = 200x − 2x², which is maximised at x = 50 (halfway to where the area would become 0).

B.text: A figure has 4 lines of symmetry and rotational symmetry of order 4. Which shape necessarily has BOTH these properties?
steps: A rectangle has only 2 lines of symmetry and rotational order 2.
A rhombus has 2 lines of symmetry and rotational order 2.
A parallelogram (general) has no lines of symmetry.
A square has 4 lines of symmetry and rotational symmetry of order 4 — it fits both conditions.

B.text: On a number line, P is at −9, Q is at −3, and R is at 7. A point S is such that Q is the midpoint of PS. Find the position of S.
steps: If Q is the midpoint of PS, then Q = (P+S)/2.

C.text: In a code, each letter is replaced by its mirror in the alphabet (A↔Z, B↔Y, C↔X, …). Using this rule, what is the code for HOLD?
steps: The mirror rule pairs letter at position p with letter at position (27−p).

C.text: In a certain code, STAR is written as 19-20-1-18. What is the code for MOON?
steps: The code uses each letter's position in the alphabet (A=1 ... Z=26).

C.text: Find the next term in the series: 2, 5, 11, 23, 47, ___
steps: Each term follows the rule: double the previous term and add 1.

C.text: Find the missing term: 3, 4, 7, 8, 11, 12, ___
Pen : Write :: Knife : ___
steps: A pen is used to write.
In the same way, a knife is used to cut.
2/3 = 8/12 — both numerator and denominator were multiplied by 4.
Applying the same rule to 3/4: multiply top and bottom by 4 to get 12/16.

C.text: Which is the odd one out?
steps: 25 is not a multiple of 6, so it's the odd one out.

C.text: Which does NOT belong to the group?
steps: Kilometre, Metre, and Centimetre are all units of length.
Kilogram is a unit of mass — it doesn't belong.

C.text: A container holds 5 litres of water. How many 250 mL cups can be filled from it?
How many days, hours, and minutes make up exactly 1510 minutes?
steps: 1510 ÷ 60 = 25 hours, remainder 10 minutes — so 25 h 10 min.

C.text: In a class of 40 students, Rohan ranks 18th from the top in Science. What is his rank from the bottom in Science?
steps: Rank from bottom = total − rank from top + 1.

C.text: A polygon has 8 sides. What is the sum of its interior angles?
In which group are ALL numbers divisible by both 3 and 4? (A) {12, 24, 30, 48}   (B) {24, 36, 48, 60}   (C) {12, 18, 24, 36}   (D) {12, 24, 42, 48}
steps: A number divisible by both 3 and 4 must be divisible by 12.
In group A, 30 isn't divisible by 12. In group C, 18 isn't. In group D, 42 isn't.
Group B — 24, 36, 48, 60 — are all divisible by 12.

C.text: How many squares of ANY size are contained in a 3 × 3 grid of unit squares?
steps: Count by size: 1×1 squares = 9, 2×2 squares = 4, 3×3 squares = 1.

C.text: An exterior angle of a regular polygon is 40°. How many sides does the polygon have?
What is the sum of the first five terms of the sequence of square numbers: 1², 2², 3², 4², 5²?
Three angles lie on one side of a straight line. Two of them are 45° and 70°. Find the third angle.
steps: Angles on one side of a straight line add up to 180°.

C.text: A transversal cuts two parallel lines. One pair of corresponding angles is (3x + 15)° and (5x − 25)°. Find x.
Which of the following is divisible by 11?
steps: Use the alternating digit sum test for 11.

C.text: A student's scores in 6 tests are: 78, 92, 85, 78, 88, 79. What is the range of the scores?
What is the smallest prime number greater than 50?
steps: 51=3×17 (not prime), 52 is even (not prime), 53 has no factors other than 1 and itself — it's prime.

C.text: A path 1.5 m wide runs outside a rectangular garden that is 30 m long and 20 m wide. Find the area of the path.
steps: Outer dimensions (garden + path on all sides) = (30+2×1.5) × (20+2×1.5) = 33 × 23 = 759 m².

C.text: Simplify: 3/8 + 5/6 − 1/4
A bottle holds 3/4 litre. How many bottles can be completely filled from 9 litres?
A perpendicular bisector of segment PQ is drawn. Which statement is TRUE?
opts: Any point on it is equidistant from P and Q
steps: A key property of a perpendicular bisector is that every point on it is the same distance from both endpoints of the segment.

C.text: The letter S has:
opts: Rotational symmetry of order 2 but no line of symmetry
steps: S looks the same after a 180° rotation (rotational symmetry of order 2), but it cannot be split into two mirror-image halves by any straight line.

C.text: The product of two integers is −36. One of them is −4. What is the other integer?
steps: Other integer = −36 ÷ (−4) = 9 (a negative divided by a negative gives a positive).

C.text: Estimate the product 498 × 32 by rounding each number to the nearest 10.
How many factors does 48 have?
What is the smallest number that is a multiple of both 7 and 11?
steps: 7 and 11 share no common factors, so their LCM is simply their product: 7×11 = 77.

C.text: Which of the following is equal to 7/20?
A school has 650 students. 2/5 of them play cricket. How many students play cricket?
A shopkeeper bought a bag for ₹850 and sold it for ₹1,020. What is the profit percentage?
A tap fills a tank at 12 litres per minute. How long will it take to fill a 540-litre tank?
Find the next term in the series: 1, 2, 4, 7, 11, 16, ___
steps: The differences increase by 1 each time: 1,2,3,4,5.
Next difference is 6, so the next term = 16+6 = 22.

C.text: A factory produces 2/3 of its monthly target in the first half of the month. In the second half, it produces 3/4 of the remaining target. What fraction is still unfinished?
steps: After the first half, remaining target = 1 − 2/3 = 1/3.
In the second half, 3/4 of that remaining 1/3 is produced: 3/4 × 1/3 = 1/4.

C.text: A right-angled triangle has legs 6 cm and 8 cm. A square is drawn with the same perimeter as this triangle. What is the area of the square?
steps: With legs 6 and 8, the hypotenuse is 10 (a 6-8-10 right triangle).
Side of equal-perimeter square = 24 ÷ 4 = 6 cm, so area = 36 cm².

C.text: In a survey of 50 students, 18 prefer Red, 15 prefer Blue, 12 prefer Green, and 5 prefer Yellow. What percentage prefer Blue or Green?
Find the smallest number that must be added to 4,875 to make it exactly divisible by 12.
steps: To reach the next multiple of 12, add 12−3 = 9.

C.text: In a group of students, every 4th is selected for Team A and every 6th for Team B. Which student number (counting from 1) is first selected for BOTH teams?
steps: The first student picked for both teams is at the LCM of 4 and 6.

C.text: In a quiz, a correct answer gives +5 marks and an incorrect answer gives −2 marks. Reena answers 8 correctly and 5 incorrectly. What is her total score?
A water tank is 4 m long, 3 m wide, and 2 m deep. If 1 cubic metre = 1000 litres, how many litres can it hold?
A toy costs ₹480. During a sale, it is sold at a 15% discount. What is the sale price?
In a bag, 3/8 of the marbles are red, 1/4 are blue, and the rest are green. If there are 40 marbles in all, how many are green?
A room 8 m × 6 m is to be tiled with square tiles of side 50 cm. How many tiles are needed?
A number, when divided by 5, gives quotient 8 and remainder 3. When this number is multiplied by 3 and then 7 is subtracted, the result is divisible by:
steps: 122 = 2 × 61, which is not divisible by 3, 4, or 6.

C.text: A train covers 2/5 of its journey, then stops. It then covers 3/7 of the remaining distance before stopping again. What fraction of the total journey is yet to be covered?
steps: The second leg covers 3/7 of that remaining 3/5: 3/7 × 3/5 = 9/35.

C.text: A rectangle has perimeter 56 cm and area 192 cm². Find the length of its longer side.
steps: l + b = 28 (half the perimeter), and l × b = 192.
Solving x² − 28x + 192 = 0 gives x = 16 or x = 12.

C.text: A square piece of paper is folded once along its diagonal, then once more along the diagonal of the resulting triangle. A hole is punched at the midpoint of the longest side. How many holes appear when fully unfolded?
steps: Each fold doubles the number of paper layers, so after 2 folds there are 4 layers stacked at the hole location.
By the symmetry of the two diagonal folds, the hole lands at the midpoint of each of the square's 4 sides when unfolded.

C.text: On a winter expedition, the temperature falls at 3°C per hour. At 6:00 AM the temperature is 5°C. At what time does the temperature reach −22°C?

D.text: If the word CLOCK is coded by reversing its letters (CLOCK → KCOLC), what is the code for WATCH?
steps: Reverse the letters of WATCH: W-A-T-C-H becomes H-C-T-A-W.

D.text: Using the rule A↔1, B↔2, …, Z↔26, what is the sum of the letter-position values of the word MANGO?
Find the next term in the series: 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, ___
steps: This is the Fibonacci sequence: each term is the sum of the two before it.

D.text: Find the missing pair: AZ, BY, CX, DW, ___
steps: The first letter moves forward (A,B,C,D,…) while the second moves backward (Z,Y,X,W,…).
Next pair: E and V, so EV.

D.text: Kilometre : Distance :: Kilogram : ___
steps: In the same way, a kilogram measures weight.
3³ = 27 — the second number is the cube of the first.

D.text: Which of the following is the odd one out?
steps: 164 is not a perfect square (12²=144, 13²=169), so it's the odd one out.

D.text: Which of the following does NOT belong to the group?
steps: Sphere, Cone, and Cylinder are 3D solids.
Circle is a flat, 2D shape — it doesn't belong.

D.text: A pipe drips at 5 mL per minute. How many litres drip in 4 hours?
Convert 8.5 km into metres.
In a row of 35 students, Nidhi is 14th from the left. How many students are to her right?
steps: Students to her right = total − her position = 35 − 14 = 21.

D.text: In an isosceles triangle, the vertex angle is 80°. Find the measure of each base angle.
steps: The two base angles are equal. Their sum = 180 − 80 = 100°.

D.text: Which grouping is correct? Group A: {8, 16, 24, 32, 40} — claimed to be multiples of 8. Group B: {15, 25, 35, 45, 65} — claimed to be odd multiples of 5.
steps: Group A: 8,16,24,32,40 are all multiples of 8 — correct.
Group B: 15,25,35,45,65 are all odd multiples of 5 (5×3, 5×5, 5×7, 5×9, 5×13) — correct too.

D.text: An equilateral triangle is divided into 4 smaller triangles by joining the midpoints of its sides. How many triangles of ANY size exist in the resulting figure?
steps: Joining the midpoints creates 4 small triangles.
Counting the original large triangle as well: 4 small + 1 large = 5 total.

D.text: For a regular polygon, the difference between each interior angle and the corresponding exterior angle is 60°. How many sides does it have?
steps: Adding these: 2×interior = 240°, so interior = 120° and exterior = 60°.

D.text: The hexagonal numbers follow the pattern 1, 7, 19, 37, … (differences increase by 6 each time). What is the next term?
steps: Differences: 6, 12, 18 — each 6 more than the last.

D.text: Two angles form a linear pair and one is twice the other. Find the larger angle.
steps: Linear pair sums to 180°. Let smaller = x, larger = 2x.

D.text: A transversal cuts two parallel lines. A pair of alternate exterior angles are (3x + 10)° and (5x − 30)°. Find x.
Using the digits 1, 3, 5, and 9 exactly once each, form the largest 4-digit number that is divisible by 9. (Digit sum = 18.)

H.text: Four lines pass through a single point, creating 8 angles. If four alternating angles sum to 200°, what is the sum of the remaining four angles?
steps: All 8 angles around the point add up to 360°, split into 4 pairs of equal vertical angles.
The 4 alternating angles chosen include 2 pairs of vertical angles, so they represent 2 distinct values doubled, summing to 200° — meaning those 2 distinct values sum to 100°.
The 4 distinct angle values together sum to 180° (half of 360°), so the other 2 distinct values sum to 180−100 = 80°.
The remaining four angles (2 pairs) then sum to 2×80 = 160°.
